content:
maya: noticed a customer report that they didn't get paged for order-processor-high-latency. I see an incident created in the console but no pager delivery. anyone seeing pager failures? :rotating_light:
incident-bot: [automated] delivery to pager-proxy failed: 502 Bad Gateway (retrying). message-id=0xabc123
maya: logs show repeated `enqueue timeout` from pager-proxy and the delivery queue spiked to ~1200 items.
jen: @oncall-alex are you getting any rings? can you confirm if the phone page hit you?
oncall-alex: nothing on my phone. I'm on-call and standing by. manually triggered a page to myself, no alert from automation.
samir: pulling pager-proxy logs — seeing constant 5xx responses to notify-gateway and connection resets. suspecting something changed in the proxy pool behavior after the 08:12 deploy.
deploy-bot: deployment "pager-proxy v2.4.1" finished to prod at 08:12 UTC (sha: a1b2c3).
jen: ok, likely correlated. samir, can you try restarting one proxy node to see if the backlog clears? we'll manual-page critical alerts in the meantime.
samir: restarted pager-proxy-3, backlog dropped from ~1200 -> ~110 but two other nodes still returning errors. manual pages now going out to oncall.
oncall-alex: I just got the manual page from maya, confirmed. :thumbsup:
maya: thanks. customer impact summary so far: 2 customer teams experienced delayed pages (8-12m). incidents were created in the UI but automated paging was delayed.
samir: digging deeper — root cause is keepalive socket exhaustion between pager-proxy and notify-gateway. v2.4.1 changed connection pool handling (max idle connections + aggressive reuse) and we hit ephemeral port/socket limits. opening revert PR now.
jen: rolling back v2.4.1 to v2.4.0 now. ETA ~5m. also enabling fallback route to sms-relay for high-priority alerts while we stabilize.
incident-bot: requeued 1200 failed deliveries, currently re-sending. 50 remain queued (priority: critical).
samir: rollback complete, all proxy nodes green. queue drained. confirming no further 5xxs in the last 3 minutes.
maya: good. ops notes: add runbook step to check socket usage and a quick restart path for proxy nodes. update alerting to create a pager if the delivery queue exceeds 500 for more than 2m.
jen: agree — also add a 'fail-open' toggle so automation can route to fallback channels when primary proxy is unhealthy. that would have prevented missed pages.
oncall-alex: assigning follow-ups: samir - root cause PR + postmortem; jen - runbook + alert rule; maya - customer comms and incident summary.
samir: logs snippet and minimal repro in case it helps: ```
curl -v "https://pager-proxy.internal/api/enqueue" -d '{"id":"0xabc123","payload":"..."}'
# observe: TCP FIN/RESET and 502 from notify-gateway
```
maya: I'll draft a short customer-facing update with timeline and mitigation.
jen: thanks everyone. postmortem to include: why automation didn't fail open, quicker detection for queued delivery spikes, and verification steps for connection pool changes before deploy.
incident-bot: [note] incident tagged and follow-ups created: #postmortem, #runbook, #customer-comms
maya: closing the live thread — will reopen if anything pops up. :white_check_mark:
